title: Lancaster Bomber ND958
memorial_details:
description: about 200 yards from the road on the edge of the tree line.
It is about one mile south of the junction of the A134 and Mill Lane Barnham. There is a group of six houses set back on the left about half way between Mill Lane and the location.
The memorial can be seen from the road but only as a white item against the green of the trees.
inscription:
RAF CREST BESIDE THE COMMEMORATION.
IN MEMEMRY OF / THE CREW WHO DIED WHEN / RAF LANCASTER ND 958 OF 3 LFS FELTWELL / CRASHED ON THIS SPOT / MONDAY 29TH JANUARY 1945 / NAMES / LEST WE FORGET
